value.rationale: The design question is mathematically natural: use two oracle calls per Heun update while retaining unbiased uniform component sampling at each stage. The complete coupling classification proves a strict universal advantage for negative dependence and locates an exact one-step termination threshold. A rational positive-definite example exhibits qualitative phase separation (exact termination versus exponential mean-square growth). These are sharp, structural and reproducible within the explicitly stated model, not a universal efficiency claim.
